title: syntheticdata-generation-catalog
summary: A Python benchmarking project that compares open-source synthetic tabular-data libraries (SDV, SynthCity, MOSTLY AI SDK, ydata-synthetic, RealTabFormer) across single-table, multi-table, and time-series datasets, scoring statistical fidelity, ML utility, and privacy. SDV is run directly as the 'foundational library' in the comparison, using its GaussianCopula, CTGAN, HMA, and PAR synthesizers via the sdv single_table/multi_table/sequential APIs, with SDMetrics used for quality evaluation.
needs: libs/sdv directory appears to be the project's own experiment scripts (depends on pip package sdv>=1.0), not a vendored copy of SDV source, despite being flagged as such.
